# Filter the dataframe to find the row with Title "Candy Sale"
candy_sale_row = df[df['Title'] == 'Candy Sale']

# Get the Series # of that episode
candy_sale_series_num = candy_sale_row['Series #'].iloc[0]

# Find the next episode by Series # (assuming Series # are sequential)
next_episode = df[df['Series #'] == candy_sale_series_num + 1]

# Extract the Title of the next episode
answer = next_episode['Title'].iloc[0]
